results.title: Job-Shop Precedence Scheduling
results.prompt: Tasks T1 (2h), T2 (3h), T3 (1h), T4 (2h). Precedences: T1 before T3; T2 before T3 and T4. With two parallel workers, what is the minimum completion time?
results.reply: The minimum completion time is 5. Since T2 must finish before both T3 and T4 can start, and it takes 3 hours, the earliest either of those can begin is at hour 3. From that point, you have two tasks remaining—T3 (1 hour) and T4 (2 hours)—which can be run in parallel by your two workers, finishing at hour 4 and hour 5 respectively.

    # At time 3, T2 is done. Now T3 and T4 are ready.
